A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

all-syn and all-anti oligomers with the same number of thiophene rings show similar pi-conjugational behavior, but that cross-conjugational effects are more important in the former than in the latter oligomers.
the all-anti oligomer series is a good model system for the study of the pi-conjugation in all-syn heterohelicenes.
, while all-syn oligohelicenes are characterized by a strong cross-conjugation effect, all-anti oligoacenes are characterized by an almost complete linear pi-conjugation effect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
FT Raman spectroscopic studies of oligothieno(helico)acenes are a powerful tool in assessing their pi-conjugational features.
the Raman spectroscopy of oligothieno- and oligothienoheteroacenes is a very useful and reliable probe for studying the pi-conjugation properties of these compounds.
